rows.maharashtra_state_common_entrance_test_c: LLB degree or LLM post-graduate degree in Law from a recognised university, holding a Sanad; knowledge of all types of laws; adequate Marathi, Hindi and English; computer work experience; minimum 5 years' experience handling court cases or 5 years' advocacy practice in any court in Maharashtra

content_sections.heading: State CET Cell Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. Astha-1926/Pra.Kra.50/Sahayyak Vidhi/2730/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download State CET Cell notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Law graduate holding an LLB degree or LLM post-graduate degree from a recognised university; Must hold a Sanad; Knowledge of all types of laws so as to carry out legal proceedings efficiently; Adequate knowledge of Marathi, Hindi and English; Experience of working on computer Experience: Minimum 5 years' experience of handling court cases in a government/semi-government office or a private establishment, OR 5 years' advocacy practice in any court in Maharashtra (mandatory) Age limit: Maximum 45 years (at the time of appointment) Other conditions: Must hold a Sanad Knowledge of all types of laws Adequate knowledge of Marathi, Hindi and English Experience of working on computer required Applicant must reside in Mumbai as work runs 24x7

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary appointment through outsourcing or an alternative method on lump-sum honorarium basis Appointment initially limited to six months only Appointee will not be counted as a government employee Services may be terminated with ten days' notice if work is unsatisfactory Minimum 1 month written notice needed to leave the job Private legal practice during the contract only with written permission of the appointing authority

rows.event: Walk-in interview (candidates present up to this date)

content_sections.heading: How Will State CET Cell Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications Interview Applications received are scrutinised as required before the interview Final authority on selection rests with the Maharashtra State CET Cell

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for State CET Cell Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear directly for interview at the Maharashtra State CET Cell with the relevant necessary documents. Candidates present up to 30-11-2026 will be interviewed at the CET Cell. No action will be taken after the prescribed date and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No travelling allowance for the interview No action after the prescribed date; no correspondence entertained Resignation not accepted except in exceptional circumstances with competent authority approval Competent authority may suspend, postpone or cancel the selection process at any time Continuing private practice after refusal of permission, causing disruption or financial loss, leads to cancellation and legal action Work is sensitive and confidential; late-night work and 24x7 availability required

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for State CET Cell Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in State CET Cell Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Law.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for State CET Cell Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (at the time of appointment).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 32,000 per month (monthly remuneration).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: LLB degree or LLM post-graduate degree in Law from a recognised university, holding a Sanad; knowledge of all types of laws; adequate Marathi, Hindi and English; computer work experience; minimum 5 years' experience handling court cases or 5 years' advocacy practice in any court in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must hold a Sanad. Knowledge of all types of laws. Adequate knowledge of Marathi, Hindi and English. Experience of working on computer required.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Interview. Applications received are scrutinised as required before the interview. Final authority on selection rests with the Maharashtra State CET Cell.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment through outsourcing or an alternative method on lump-sum honorarium basis. Appointment initially limited to six months only. Appointee will not be counted as a government employee.
